p1c5.caption: Six errors collapsing into the noon disc
p1c5.opener: POSTER (T4 + Cinzel percent rule): an airy opener, NOT a giant hero — generous top/bottom padding, compact horizontal emblem (~270px) above a SMALL Cinzel title (600 weight, small end of the clamp, wider tracking; monumentality through spacing, not size), then the six-diamond cadence strip below the meta-rule. Explicit end state: the engraved noon-disc seal below the final paragraph so the 256-word chapter reads finished. No drop cap: the opening line 'History of an Error' is a subtitle.
p1c5.palette_role: Brightest bronze in the cohort. The noon centre is ENGRAVED bronze line-work only — radial ticks + dot + 5 concentric sounding-rings — never a flat gold fill (T5: Gay Science separation; their noon is flat mural gold, ours is line-engraving). Ember appears once, as the crack feeding the disc.
p1c5.part_subtitle: How to Philosophize with a Hammer
p1c5.rationale: The whole chapter is one joke with six beats: the 'real world' idea thins from Plato's noon-sun ('I, Plato, am the truth') through Christian promise, Kantian mist, positivist cock-crow, to cheerful abolition — ending at literal noon ('moment of the shortest shadow; INCIPIT ZARATHUSTRA'). Five shrinking bronze discs dramatize the thinning; lengthening-to-vanishing shadows under each stage literalize the shortest-shadow line; the sixth position is the noon disc itself, struck (bronze starburst) and cracked (one ember polyline) like every cohort emblem, and ringed by exactly 5 honest sounding-rings (T1: ring count = book position). The cadence strip echoes the six stages inside the reading flow so the tiny chapter keeps its fable rhythm.
p1c5.reading_treatment: BENCHMARK v3. Calm Cormorant body at 1.2rem with extra air. TWO VOICES: the six numbered stage-sentences set upright with Cinzel bronze stage numerals; the parenthetical asides (including the split P7 aside + stage 4, and the closing INCIPIT ZARATHUSTRA aside) set in Cormorant italic, indented, as the fable's whispering chorus — the engineer wraps asides in styling spans, prose strings unchanged. 'INCIPIT ZARATHUSTRA' in letterspaced Cinzel bone inside the final aside. End state: the engraved noon-disc seal (symbol idol-fable-seal: 3 bronze rings + dot + shortest-shadow tick, ~52px) below the final paragraph.
p1c5.title: How the Real World Finally Became a Fable

p1c6.caption: Shears beneath the uncut flame of passion
p1c6.opener: Standard cohort opener: emblem (~215px) → Cinzel title → roman numeral → bronze meta-rule. The flame sits high in the emblem so the composition reads as 'that which the shears cannot reach'.
p1c6.palette_role: Ember shears against a bronze-lit flame; bone line-engraving; exactly 6 honest sounding-rings alternating bronze/ash (T1). Ember is the weapon here, bronze the life it fails to cut.
p1c6.part_subtitle: How to Philosophize with a Hammer
p1c6.rationale: The chapter's war is castratism vs spiritualization: the church's answer to passion is 'il faut tuer les passions' — excision, eradication, the ideal castrato saint — while Nietzsche's answer is passion 'marrying the spirit' (sensuality spiritualized = love; enmity spiritualized = the fruitful opposite). The emblem stages exactly that standoff: open bone shears, strike-star on the pivot, an ember crack running down one blade — and above them, untouched, the flame of passion ringed by six sounding-rings. The shears strike; the flame rings. Also echoes the 'peace of soul' catalogue (P4–P5) as what the shears produce: quiet, not life.
p1c6.reading_treatment: BENCHMARK v3. Calm Cormorant body with a bronze Cinzel drop cap on P1 ('All passions…'). 'PEACE OF SOUL' CATALOGUE (P4 tail + P5): the anaphoric 'Or …' clauses — 'Or the onset of tiredness… Or unwitting gratitude… Or laziness…' — each open on a hanging line with the 'Or' in small Cinzel bronze caps (engineer wraps each 'Or'-clause in a styling span; prose unchanged), so the catalogue scans as a litany of false peaces against the chapter's war on castratism. End state: engraved flame seal (symbol idol-flame-seal: small flame in double ring with one ember crack-tick), replacing the Psi glyph idea.
p1c6.title: Morality As Anti-Nature

p1c7.caption: The idol of causality split into four errors
p1c7.opener: Widest cracks in the book. Emblem (~210px) → Cinzel title → numeral → rule. The emblem's four ember crack-arms radiating from the bronze strike-star preview the chapter's four named errors before a word is read; 7 honest sounding-rings (T1) close around the quartered disc.
p1c7.palette_role: Full cohort grammar at maximum violence: bone idol-disc, ash quadrant lines, bronze strike-star, four ember crack-arms, 7 alternating bronze/ash rings. The only emblem with ember in four places.
p1c7.part_subtitle: How to Philosophize with a Hammer
p1c7.rationale: The longest chapter (2,622 words, 12 paras) is built as four named errors plus two load-bearing interludes, each announced by an em-dash head inside the prose: Error of Confusing Cause and Consequence (Cornaro's diet — consequence mistaken for cause), Error of a False Causality ('I' as cause, will/mind/I dissolved), Psychological Explanation interlude (any explanation better than none; banker/Christian/girl), Imaginary Causes (morality/religion as mistranslated physiology; cannon-shot dream), Error of Free Will (theologians' trick; 'metaphysics of the hangman'), closing in the innocence of becoming. The emblem quarters the idol-disc with one glyph per error: reversed double-arrow (cause/consequence), struck-through I-beam (false causality), sleeping star under a dream-arc (imaginary causes: cannon-shot dream), broken yoke (free will). In-flow, each named head becomes a Cinzel plate-head with an engraved SVG phase-disc (waxing fill per error: quarter/half/three-quarter/full, bronze on bone ring; ash hollow disc for the Psychological interlude) — honoring the numbered structure with engraved plates, never 01/02/03 badges and never font-glyph sigils.
p1c7.reading_treatment: BENCHMARK v3. Each error opens a ruled 'plate' (hairline top rule, extra top margin); its em-dash head is lifted to a Cinzel small-caps plate-head on its own line (engineer splits at the first em dash — prose wording unchanged), led by its engraved phase-disc SVG (symbols idol-phase-1/2/3/4, ~15px inline): P1 'Error of Confusing Cause and Consequence' (quarter-fill), P3 'Error of a False Causality' (half-fill), P6 'Psychological Explanation for This' (ash hollow disc, symbol idol-phase-0 — load-bearing interlude, not a numbered error), P8 'The Entire Realm of Morality and Religion Belongs Under This Concept of Imaginary Causes' (three-quarter fill, bronze — the third error's head), P9 'Error of Free Will' (full disc with forge pip). Body otherwise calm Cormorant; no drop cap (P1 opens mid-argument). End state: engraved quartered-disc seal (symbol idol-quarters-seal: cross-quartered ring, four ember crack-ticks, bronze centre dot), replacing the cross glyph.
p1c7.title: The Four Great Errors

p1c8.caption: The pious mask over the lying tablets
p1c8.opener: Standard cohort opener: emblem (~210px) → Cinzel title → numeral → rule. The ember crack runs the full face of the mask — the single longest crack in the cohort — because this chapter names the fraud outright. 8 honest sounding-rings (T1), the densest set in our cohort.
p1c8.palette_role: Ash veil-lines and bone mask; three bronze diamonds for the three named lawgivers; ember for the crossed-out eye and the full-face crack — the lie exposed. 8 alternating bronze/ash rings.
p1c8.part_subtitle: How to Philosophize with a Hammer
p1c8.rationale: Two zoological 'improvements' — taming (the church as menagerie, the blond beast caged into a 'sinner') and breeding (Manu's four castes, Chandala law) — converge on one verdict: the pia fraus, the holy lie, 'the legacy of all the philosophers and priests'. Neither Manu nor Plato nor Confucius doubted their right to lie. The emblem is the fraud made visible: a priestly mask (brow-band, three bronze diamonds = Manu/Plato/Confucius), one living eye, one eye crossed out in ember, ash veil-lines across the lower face, and the cohort's longest ember crack splitting the mask from the bronze strike-star at the crown. The strike lands on the crown because the chapter strikes the lawgivers, not the law.
p1c8.reading_treatment: BENCHMARK v3. Calm Cormorant with bronze Cinzel drop cap on P1. P2 ('Morality is merely sign language…') is the chapter's thesis sentence — centered italic maxim treatment, bone. Movement sigils as engraved SVG minis (~16px) in the margin (inline before text on phone): caged-grid seal (symbol idol-sigil-cage) at P3 for the menagerie/taming movement, four-tier pyramid seal (symbol idol-sigil-tiers) at P5 for Manu breeding, ember-cross-in-ring seal (symbol idol-sigil-fraus) at P7–P8 for the pia fraus — never font glyphs. End state: engraved fraus seal (symbol idol-fraus-seal: broken ring + ember cross + bronze pip), the only ember-dominant seal in the cohort, sealing the verdict 'fundamentally immoral'.
p1c8.title: The 'Improvers' Of Humanity

cohort_notes: Demolition core of the book: our emblems carry the most violent cracks (four ember arms in p1c7, full-face split in p1c8) while p1c5 uniquely resolves toward light. T1: ring counts are honest content — 5/6/7/8 per chapter, recorded in each entry's rings field. T4: p1c5 is a poster with an explicit noon-disc end seal. T5: p1c5's noon is engraved bronze line-work, never flat gold — the earlier noon-fill token is REMOVED from the palette. All four emblems verified in a rendered prototype v2 (desktop + 390px phone) before this manifest was finalized. BENCHMARK v3: every glyph end-mark/sigil (⊙ Ψ ✚ ✕ ▦ ≣ ◐◑◒◓) is replaced by an engraved SVG symbol authored in art/idolsmasher.svg; in-flow treatments added for the p1c5 two-voice fable, the p1c6 'peace of soul' catalogue, p1c7's phase-disc plates, and p1c8's margin seals. Treatments sheet verified in a rendered prototype (desktop + phone).

design.composition: Centered monumental openers per book-identity: #chapter-art emblem → part eyebrow → Cinzel title → roman numeral → bronze meta-rule → quiet body. p1c5's poster opener is deliberately smaller and airier (percent rule) to stay proportional to 256 words while reading finished via its end seal.

direction_comparison.name: A. Stave-and-sigil chant (rejected)
direction_comparison.note: Grey-chant-stave opener with neume-like sigils per error; beautiful for p1c7 but liturgical-calm across all four — wrong temperature for polemic, and no honest link to the hammer procedure.

direction_comparison.name: B. Broadside wood-type wall (rejected)
direction_comparison.note: Aggressive poster openers, oversized numerals per error. Strong for p1c7/p1c8 but crushes tiny p1c5 and the calm-body rule; numerals-as-hero was explicitly rejected as baseline.

direction_comparison.name: C. Struck-bronze sounding-points (CHOSEN, conforms to book-identity)
direction_comparison.note: Each chapter one hammer-touch: ivory line-engraving, bronze strike-star + concentric sounding-rings, ember crack. Literalizes Nietzsche's stated procedure; scales from p1c5's delicate noon-disc to p1c7's fourfold shatter; keeps body calm.

design.illustration: Original hand-authored SVG line-engraving: bone (#EDE2CC) strokes 1–2px on forge-black, bronze (#D29A4A) strike-starbursts and sounding-rings, ember (#B23A2A) cracks only. No stock, no gradients-as-idea, no pseudo-element ticks. Sounding-rings alternate solid-bronze and dashed-ash; exact counts per chapter (5/6/7/8) are normative — validator checks them. BENCHMARK v3: zero font-glyphs as art — all sigils, seals, and phase-discs are engraved SVG symbols in the cohort file (see engineer_notes.symbols).
references: MoMA Inside/Out: Apollinaire's Visual Poetry (calligramme Revolver study) — word-as-image precedent for the p1c5 cadence strip and phase-sigil plate-heads. https://www.moma.org/explore/inside_out/2014/02/27/apollinaires-visual-poetry/
NGA: Los Caprichos by Francisco Goya (1799, 80 etching/aquatints) — etched satirical series precedent; each chapter a struck plate. https://www.nga.gov/artworks/7450-los-caprichos

Public Domain Review: Apollinaire's Calligrammes (1918) — typographical audacity / visual lyricism as the license for shaped fable layout. https://publicdomainreview.org/collection/apollinaire-s-calligrammes-1918
